The observer now formats the underlying Feet float through FieldText. The recorded O-1 launch passed assertions on the observer’s actual output of 6.25 for the donor and 6 for the owned spear. S-11 remains in the simulated session, whose completion evidence is tracked under R3-F1.

The probe captures the incoming selection and current character, restores them before caster destruction, and fails cleanup on a mismatch. The recorded empty-selection, single-selection and pre-targeted refusal controls passed. The empty-selection case includes an independent check after cleanup.
The developer added the requested values to the investigation, but the supplied transcript and evidence directory still lack the machine-produced result needed to verify them.
